message: Hey Jane! I couldn't wait to tell you that Mark proposed to me last night! We're engaged!!! 🥰💍
Morning, Jane! Did you see the news about the Harrison's new bakery opening next week? We should totally share this!
Jane, you won't believe it! Little Timmy took his first steps today! It was so precious! 😊
Hey, I just finished the marathon in record time for me! Feeling proud and exhausted! 🏃‍♂️
Jane, Aunt Martha's 90th birthday party was a hit! We missed you there.
Reminder: Family reunion this summer! Save the date: June 25th.
Jane, I just got promoted to regional manager! Drinks on me this weekend!
Book club alert: Next meeting is on the 20th. We're discussing 'The Great Gatsby'.
Valentine's Day dinner was perfect. Thanks for recommending that restaurant, Jane!
Jane, our team won the championship! Can't wait to celebrate with everyone!
